com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Add one invoice line with the values you specify. Records a correction; financial changes can reset approval. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview adding a line to our fictional practice invoice: description Fictional packing, quantity 2, unit price 12.50, tax amount 0 and total 25.00 in the invoice's currency. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare one explicit new invoice line with supplied values. Requires confirmation and records a correction. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
name: preview_add_invoice_line_item
title: Preview: Add an invoice line
